subject: F89 source task: localize digest and Relay dashboard surfaces
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: F89-DIGEST-RELAY-LOCALIZATION-R1
WIRE: CODEX-F89-DIGEST-RELAY-L10N-R1-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Verify the exact source and return correlated ACK then implementation evidence or BLOCKED
REASON: NONE
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_SHA: 97e4d8b4f5a52a6f073b07cf468df9b85d126b7d
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f89-digest-relay-localization-r1
SCOPE: Implement missing F-89 catalog adoption only in packages/dashboard/app/digests/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/GenerateDigestButton.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/DigestScheduleStatus.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RecoverDigestSchedule.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RelayCardHistory.tsx and packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/relay/page.tsx. Reuse @axiom/core and the existing useLocale provider. Add only typed keys and six translations required by those surfaces: en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de. Preserve authenticated API calls, idempotency/retry behavior, loading/empty/error states, accessibility labels and truthful stored-vs-external-delivery wording. Do not translate creator content, provider payloads, IDs, timestamps or generated text implicitly.
PASS_CRITERIA: Verify and copy only SOURCE_SHA. Return one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED before coding. Then one evidence-bearing PROGRESS naming changed files and a real test command. Terminal DELIVERY must list changed paths, per-file SHA-256, exact commands and exit codes, behavior tests proving all six catalogs contain the new keys, named surfaces render localized labels and truthful empty/error/retry/delivery states, and no required translation silently falls back to English. Run focused dashboard tests, core catalog tests and dashboard typecheck. If a named surface already consumes the catalog, leave it unchanged and report evidence. Do not invent routes, catalogs or migrations. If the source contract cannot support the scope, return terminal BLOCKED with the exact conflict.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified delivery, runs owning checks, commits and pushes. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery.
sincerely, Codex
